title: OAuthTemplate
description:
OAuthTemplate holds the set of available fields that can be configured when creating
or updating an OAuth integration in Posit Connect.

id.description: The primary identifier for this OAuth template.

name.description: A human readable name for this OAuth template.

description.description: A human readable description for this OAuth template.

sections.description:
The sections of the template are used to group fields and options when
building the UI.

options.description:
The options of the template are used to define the set of boolean and
drop-down inputs that the user configures when creating an OAuth
integration.

fields.description:
The fields of the template are used to define the set of text inputs that
the user configures when creating an OAuth integration.

environment_variables.description: The names of environment variables associated with this OAuth template.

OAuthTemplateSection.description: OAuthTemplateSection defines a section within an OAuth template used to group options and fields when building the UI.

id.description: The primary identifier of the template section.

order.description:
The order of this section relative to other sections within the OAuth
template.

ServicePrincipalTemplateField.description: A configuration field (text input) for a service principal template.

name.description: The primary identifier of the field, used as a config map key.

order.description: The order of this field relative to other options and fields.

label.description: The label to use for this field.

visibility_expression.description: A Boolean expression tree that indicates if this field is visible.

default.description: The default value of this field.

validation.description: A regular expression used to determine whether the input is valid.

validation_description.description: A description of the value constraints for this field.

secret.description: Indicates whether the field value is secret and should be hidden.

multiline.description: Indicates whether the field accepts multiline text input.

ServicePrincipalTemplateOption.description: A configuration option (boolean or drop-down input) for a service principal template.

name.description: The primary identifier of the option, used as a config map key.

order.description: The order of this option relative to other options and fields.

label.description: The label to use for this option.

visibility_expression.description: A Boolean expression tree that indicates if this option is visible.

type.description: The type of this option, either "bool" or "select".

values.description: The possible values when type is "select".

default.description: The default value of this option.

ServicePrincipalTemplateVisibilityExpres.description:
A Boolean expression tree that indicates if a specific option or field is
allowed by the service principal configuration.

name.description: The name of a config field being compared. Set only on leaf nodes.

value.description: The value a config field is compared against. Set only on leaf nodes.

operator.description: A Boolean operator applied to the operands. Set only on non-leaf nodes.

operands.description: The operands a Boolean operator applies to. Set only on non-leaf nodes.
